coverageNotes: Covers selecting the complete related set while maintaining a copied field. Does not test schema design, pagination by owner age, or initial copy creation.

questions.question: Which expression replaces `SELECT_DOGS`?

options.rationale: Selecting by age also updates dogs belonging to another owner with that age.
Taking one misses further dogs belonging to the same owner.
Collecting the whole table updates unrelated owners’ dogs.
The owner-ID index selects all and only that owner’s dogs.
